name: Jinmu - Kamunagara - Ichi Ni San
original_name: 神武－カムナガラ－壱・弐・参
source:
Main character dreams of meeting his missing sister again. One day he meets a girl who looks exactly like sister. The next day he returns to that place only to find her fighting another girl with swords...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公梦想与失踪的妹妹重逢。一天，他遇见一个与妹妹长得一模一样的女孩。第二天，他回到相遇之地，却看见她正持剑与另一个女孩战斗…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
